description_html:
A spectacular triplex penthouse apartment, one of only six penthouses of this style (Type 4B), on the 37th floor with views both north and west towards the London Eye and St. Pauls Cathedral. This four-bedroom penthouse has five bathrooms and a terrace at each level. As you enter the apartment you are greeted by full-height solid doors, bespoke lighting and a coat cupboard. There are also two bedrooms on this level both having fitted wardrobes and wall storage. The bathroom and shower room have Philippe Starck sanitary ware; natural, ivory-honed limestone wall tiles and porcelain floor tiles.

As you enter the apartment you are greeted by full-height solid doors, bespoke lighting and a coat cupboard. There are also two bedrooms on this level both having fitted wardrobes and wall storage. The bathroom and shower room have Philippe Starck sanitary ware; natural, ivory-honed limestone wall tiles and porcelain floor tiles.

Following the brushed steel-lighted staircase, including a feature chandelier, to the second floor, you will find the principal bedroom suite occupying the entire floor. The dressing area provides an extensive range of walnut storage and walk-in wardrobes, special features include a drinks fridge and speaker cabling. The area can be screened off entirely, providing an entertaining room with access onto a large terrace offering spectacular views across southwest London.

The bathroom includes a remote-controlled flat-screen TV, large walnut and limestone vanity units with a modern feature basin, walnut floor and ivory limestone wall tiles. The large walk-in shower enclosure has pale green glass, panelled walls, limestone flooring, clear glass wash hand basin and linen storage area.

The top floor, which was originally a conservatory room, has been converted into a further bedroom with an en-suite shower room and features an air conditioning unit, remote-controlled timber ceiling blinds, wooden flooring and access onto a private terrace.

Parking and storage cages are available by separate negotiation.

Situated within the City of London, you are walking distance to both Barbican and Farringdon stations (Elizabeth line) for easy access to the City with the West End , Home Counties, Canary Wharf and three of London's five airports. Clerkenwell with its plethora of Bars and restaurants is also nearby with its five-star hotels and the many banks, law firms and businesses nearby including TikTok who have recently moved into the area.

Tenure: Leasehold
